headline.statement: Negative control. The covariance recovery rule reaches MCC 0.8977 with exact population covariances (0.8947 from samples), against 0.9992 for the precision rule, so it sits below the 0.9 recovery bar before any sampling error. Its arm verdicts measure that bias, not gate calibration.
headline.relabel_note: Run first as 'Backbone B'. Relabelled a negative control on 2026-09-26 after the Mac preview showed its recovery rule reaches MCC 0.898 with exact population covariances; the decision was made after that number was seen.

config.arm_C_basis: detectability-based, NOT P3 (P3 is temporal-only, R1)

backbone.name: covariance readout
backbone.recovery_rule: w_i = v_max(Cov(Y_0) - Cov(Y_e(i))), Z_i = Y_0 w_i
backbone.null: size-matched; disjoint split when n_e <= n_0/2, else two-resample
backbone.relabel_note: Run first as 'Backbone B'. Relabelled a negative control on 2026-09-26 after the Mac preview showed its recovery rule reaches MCC 0.898 with exact population covariances; the decision was made after that number was seen.

A_environment_starvation.expectation: gate n_recoverable=m tracks naive recovered directions; PROCEED->CAPPED at m<5

B_power_starvation.expectation: gate grows conservative (count drops/abstains) before sample-robust naive fails

C_measurement_contamination.expectation: detectability gate cannot tell measurement from mechanism (no P3); partially fooled

D_weak_signal_starvation.expectation: gate grows conservative as intervention weakens before signal-robust naive fails

central_claim: covariance readout (negative control) on the E2 arms: behaviors {'A_environment_starvation': 'TRACKS_CONSERVATIVE', 'B_power_starvation': 'FLAT_OR_SILENT', 'C_measurement_contamination': 'TRACKS_CONSERVATIVE', 'D_weak_signal_starvation': 'TRACKS_CONSERVATIVE'}; tracking arms ['A_environment_starvation', 'C_measurement_contamination', 'D_weak_signal_starvation']; fooled arms []; silent-failure arms ['B_power_starvation']. Same-code precision behaviors {'A_environment_starvation': 'TRACKS_TIGHT', 'B_power_starvation': 'TRACKS_CONSERVATIVE', 'C_measurement_contamination': 'FOOLED', 'D_weak_signal_starvation': 'TRACKS_TIGHT'}. Arms where it differs from precision: ['A_environment_starvation', 'B_power_starvation', 'C_measurement_contamination', 'D_weak_signal_starvation'] (recorded, not tuned).
arm_C_note: detectability-based, NOT P3: the covariance/precision gate cannot separate measurement from mechanism without a temporal P3 (R1).

preregistered_expectation.statement: gate abstains or caps under power and weak-signal starvation and is fooled by measurement contamination, as the precision gate is

precision_same_code.note: precision readout run in this job on the same code; the comparator for every arm

population_decomposition.setting: arm A, m=5, n=2000, iv_scale=0.1, seeds 0-9
